org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal

Packages that use org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal
Package
Description
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops
Petstore console operations pages: background jobs and the audit log.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages
Builder twins of the petstore console pages: each page's .ftlh file rebuilt with PageSpec, served when the page is requested with ?builder.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal
Raw command output in the browser: a byte-offset endpoint over a TerminalSource and an xterm.js panel that renders it the way a terminal would.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal.bus
Connects terminals to the Juneau server bus: the term.input upstream handler, and the term.nudge:<id> downstream nudges that tell a terminal card when new bytes are ready.
